parent_objective: audit no-rollout bounded panel materialization before reset or measured execution
blocked_by: M1771 must be audited before reset feasibility or execution design
supersedes: direct bounded-panel reset preflight without materialization audit

public_gates: M1772 must use only M1771 artifacts and M1770 design context
M1772 must decide whether to admit reset-only feasibility preflight, materialization repair, metric-contract audit, or stop
M1772 must not run reset, rollout, train, replay, PPO, promote, use private holdout, tune profiles, or rank controller families
M1772 must preserve that M1771 is no-rollout materialization evidence only

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits no-rollout bounded panel materialization before any reset or measured execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1771 counts or role balance are inconsistent
stop if actor/input or no-ranking guardrails were violated
stop if reset feasibility would be attempted before metric-contract ambiguity is resolved
fallback_plan: route to reset-only feasibility preflight if M1771 is coherent
route to materialization repair if counts or contracts are wrong
route to metric-contract audit if role metrics remain ambiguous

admission_evidence: M1771 reports 24 specs, 4 role panels, 288 cells, zero contract violations, and zero guardrail violations
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1772 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for reset preflight or repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; M1772 audits task-quality panel materialization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Audit must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If audit finds materialization insufficient, classify as panel-design or metric-contract issue, not self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1771 materialization can be audited as coherent enough to admit a reset-only feasibility preflight.
success_criteria: M1772 makes the next route explicit
M1772 preserves no-reset no-rollout no-training no-ranking and no-paper-claim guardrails
failure_criteria: audit ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1771 materialization artifacts without reset or rollout

decision_rule: M1772 passes if it audits M1771 and chooses the next route without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
